channel.title: M&A and ownership: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New m&a and ownership filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: TAIHAN Fiberoptics board decides to absorb wholly owned subsidiary TFO Networks in a small-scale merger with no new shares issued.
Aroot's board approved absorbing wholly owned subsidiary NSRC in a small-scale merger, replacing a shareholder meeting; merger date is 1 January 2027.
Apro to absorb wholly owned subsidiary Greenbolt Pickle No.1 in a small-scale merger without issuing new shares
Joosung's board approved a small-scale absorption merger with Converz Networks in place of a shareholder meeting; no shareholders objected.
Joosung's board, in place of a shareholder meeting, approved its small-scale absorption merger with RPT Korea on November 23, 2026.
Singsongholdings subsidiary Singsong Industrial to absorb wholly owned subsidiary Gwangseok Foods in a no-new-share small-scale merger, effective 2026-12-29
Singsongholdings subsidiary Singsong Industrial to absorb wholly owned Nonsan Foods in a no-new-share small-scale merger, effective 2026-12-29.
Aribiolab's largest shareholder Aribio Holdings had its pledge on 3,948,813 shares released on 23 November 2026 after repaying a KRW 4.0bn loan.
Aribiolab's largest shareholder Aribio Holdings pledged all 3,948,813 shares to Aribio Co. as security for a KRW 4.0bn loan.
KT Skylife decides to absorb wholly owned subsidiary KT HCN in a small-scale merger with no new shares issued.
KT Skylife's board decided to absorb its wholly owned subsidiary kt HCN in a no-capital-increase merger, with the merger date set for June 30, 2027.
Daewon's board approved the small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary Daewon Mobang, replacing a shareholder meeting, effective 1 January 2027.
Eutilex's largest shareholder changed to Kwon Byung-se and 3 related parties with 12.18% after shares transferred in December 2025 were returned.
Neorigin: largest shareholder of its corporate largest shareholder changes from Xi Zhu to Optimal Success Investments Limited via share transfer on 2026-11-18.
WooGeneB&GCO largest shareholder Kang Jae-gu released a pledge on 127,706 shares after fully repaying a KRW 290mn IBK loan.
Celemics largest shareholder Park Jong-gab pledges 487,425 shares as collateral for KRW 3.2bn loan guarantee; enforcement would cut stake to 6.80%.
Samyung ENC's largest shareholder changed to Five Ocean Co., Ltd., which holds 75.27% after a third-party rights offering under its rehabilitation plan.
Wellient's tender offer for I Family SC drew 3,084,986 shares, below the 3,336,277-share minimum, so no shares were purchased.
Jin Air amended its merger report after MOLIT approval of the Air Busan and Air Seoul merger and an extended FTC grace period.
Air Busan amends its merger filing to reflect MOLIT merger approval, a KFTC holding-company grace period extension and Vietnam clearance.
Gridwiz decided to absorb its wholly owned subsidiary IDR Service in a small-scale merger, with the merger date set for January 1, 2027.
Yukil CNS completed its KRW 25.0bn acquisition of land and building in Songdo, Incheon, from Onhill after final payment on 10 November 2026.
ITEN CTS subsidiary C Platform will absorb its wholly owned subsidiary 2KM Systems in a no-new-share merger, effective 2026-12-31.
iFamilySC's board supports Welliant's tender offer for its shares at KRW 12,000 per share, running October 23 to November 11, 2026.
SNT Motiv completed its small-scale, no-new-share merger with wholly owned subsidiary SNT Robotics on November 3, 2026.
Korea Steel board backs KISCO Holdings' KRW 13,000-per-share delisting tender offer while leaving the decision to shareholders.
SK Gas completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary SK Advanced on November 4, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Hanwha Machinery & Services Holdings' largest shareholder changed to Kim Dong-seon (75.51% with 6 others) after a tender offer settled on 2026-11-04.
Kim Dong-seon becomes largest shareholder of Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings with 32.99% of common shares after a tender offer on 2026-11-04.
Sunny Electronics' largest shareholder changed to KX Innovation Co., Ltd. and 6 others, holding 25.38% after an over-the-counter purchase.
KX Innovation became Sunny Electronics' largest shareholder after buying 1,877,873 shares off-market on 2026-11-02; group holds 25.38%.
Hankook Carbon completed its small-scale merger absorbing wholly owned subsidiary Lips Co., Ltd. on November 2, 2026, with no new shares issued.
Hankuk Carbon completed its small-scale merger with wholly owned subsidiary Korea Aviation Technology KAT on November 2, 2026 without issuing new shares.
SJG Sejong completed its small-scale absorption of wholly owned subsidiary SJG Central Research Institute on October 30, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Metalabs completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary Meta S&C on November 1, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Sempio Foods filed a merger securities registration statement to issue 4,208,546 common shares totaling KRW 88.6bn.
